functions.name: mustAuth
functions.rationale: HTTP middleware that validates JWT token, extracts user_id claim, verifies user exists and isn't banned/logged-out, then injects *models.User into request context via CtxUserKey. Core authentication gate.

functions.name: canAuth
functions.rationale: Like mustAuth but optional — injects user into context if authenticated, but allows unauthenticated requests through. Used for public pages that show different content based on auth state.

functions.name: adminHandler
functions.rationale: Rejects requests unless the current user is a super administrator.

functions.name: postCreateMod
functions.rationale: Enforces the super-administrator requirement before creating a moderator.

functions.name: postDeleteMod
functions.rationale: Enforces super-administrator and same-domain checks before deleting a moderator.

functions.name: postCategory
functions.rationale: Rejects category updates outside the current administrator's domain or role.

functions.name: editComment
functions.rationale: Enforces the topic read-only policy and rejects disallowed comment operations.

functions.name: profileHandler
functions.rationale: Enforces authentication, ownership, same-domain, and moderator-role checks for profile changes.

functions.name: postAuthSignIn
functions.rationale: Enforces the domain policy controlling whether password-based sign-in is permitted.

functions.name: getAuthSignUp
functions.rationale: Validates the domain signup policy and signup capability token before showing registration.

functions.name: postAuthSignUp
functions.rationale: Validates the domain signup policy and signup capability token before creating an account.
